behaviors.source: GH #262 AC1 (prd.md D7, D8, D13, D32)
behaviors.given: a directory holding three case files named 03-c.json, 01-a.json and 02-b.json directly inside it plus a subdirectory containing a fourth JSON file, each case carrying exactly version, id, role, source, prompt, files and expected
behaviors.then: it returns an EvalPack whose cases are the three top-level files in byte-wise ascending file-name order (01-a, 02-b, 03-c), ignoring the subdirectory, and src/eval-pack.ts exports EVAL_PACK_VERSION, SUPPORTED_EVAL_PACK_VERSIONS, EVAL_ROLES, EvalRole, EvalCase, EvalExpected, EvalPack, readEvalPack and the pure validateEvalCase
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the returned cases' ids in order, that the subdirectory file is absent, and that each exported name is importable and typechecks

behaviors.given: two packs, each built in its own per-test temporary directory and neither committed: one case file with an extra top-level member and one case file missing a required member
behaviors.then: each call throws, the whole pack is refused rather than the defective case skipped, and the message names the case file and the offending member
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test in src/eval-pack.test.ts named for B-02 asserts the throw and that the message contains both the file name and the member name, for both packs

behaviors.given: one pack whose single case carries version 2, and a second pack whose two cases carry version 1 and version 2
behaviors.then: both are refused, the first for a version outside SUPPORTED_EVAL_PACK_VERSIONS ([1]) and the second for files that disagree on version
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts each thrown message names the offending file and that EVAL_PACK_VERSION === 1 and SUPPORTED_EVAL_PACK_VERSIONS deep-equals [1]

behaviors.given: a pack whose single case sets role to "generator"
behaviors.then: the whole pack is refused
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the thrown message names the file and the value "generator", and that EVAL_ROLES deep-equals ["evaluator-contract", "evaluator-qa", "evaluator-final", "planner", "pm", "architect"]

behaviors.given: three packs: an evaluator-qa case whose expected omits failureClass, an evaluator-contract case whose expected adds failureClass, and an evaluator-final case whose expected verdict is "ACCEPT"
behaviors.then: each is refused at read time before any dispatch, because expected is validated against the case's role
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts each thrown message names the file and the offending key (failureClass / verdict), and that validateEvalCase rejects the same three values

behaviors.given: packs whose files keys are respectively "C:/x.md", "/x.md", "a/../b.md" and "./x.md", plus a pack whose files value is { "fromFile": "fixtures/missing.json" } with no such file on disk
behaviors.then: each is refused, and the fromFile refusal happens at read time before any dispatch
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts each thrown message names the file and the offending key, and that the stub provider recorded zero invocations for the fromFile pack

behaviors.given: packs with, respectively, two cases sharing an id, an id "Bad_Id", a blank source, a blank prompt, and an empty directory
behaviors.then: each of the five is refused
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts each thrown message names the file (or the directory, for zero case files) and the offending member, and that the id pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,79}$ rejects "Bad_Id"

behaviors.given: a one-case pack whose files declare an inline UTF-8 file with no trailing newline and a fromFile-copied binary-ish fixture, and a stub provider that writes an artifact contradicting the case's expected so the outcome is MISMATCH and B-17 keeps the scratch directory
behaviors.when: runEvalCli dispatches the pack with the real mkScratchDir dep
behaviors.then: InvokeOptions.cwd is a fresh directory under the OS temp directory whose basename starts with afk-eval-<id>-, containing exactly the declared files with byte-identical content and nothing else
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test reads the recorded options.cwd after the run (it survives because the case is a MISMATCH), asserts the basename prefix, asserts the recursive listing equals the declared key set, and compares both files' bytes with the source bytes

behaviors.given: a six-case pack, one case per EVAL_ROLES member, dispatched to the stub provider
behaviors.when: the run completes and the recorded InvokeOptions are read
behaviors.then: the pm case carries role "pm-review", agent "pm-review" and bare true, the architect case role "architect-review", agent "architect-review" and bare true, the planner and three evaluator cases carry their production role with no agent and no bare, and every case carries the case's prompt, its scratch cwd and a logStream opened on <out>/eval-<timestamp>/<case-id>.log
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the recorded options per role and that roleDispatch(role) returns the matching invokeOptions template, artifactFile, parse and project members; the per-case log files exist in the run's output directory

behaviors.source: GH #262 AC10 (prd.md D9; src/contract-review.ts:369, src/qa-review.ts:346, src/final-evaluation.ts:305)
behaviors.given: scratch directories holding a contract-review.json written by writeContractReview, a qa-review.json written by writeQAReview, and a hand-authored schema-valid final-review.json, each nested one directory deep
behaviors.when: projectOutput(role, scratchDir) runs for evaluator-contract, evaluator-qa and evaluator-final
behaviors.then: each artifact is found recursively, parsed with the unmodified production parser, and projected to { verdict } — plus failureClass for evaluator-qa — with no findings, ids, prose or tree ids
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts each returned projection deep-equals the expected object exactly (own keys included) and that src/eval-compare.ts exports projectOutput and compareProjection

behaviors.given: three planner scratch directories: one holding a planner-escalation.md whose content is JSON.stringify(REVISION_PLANNER_ESCALATION), one holding no sentinel plus one acceptance-manifest.json from writeAcceptanceManifest with a contract.md beside it, and one holding a planner-escalation.md containing "{ not json"
behaviors.then: the first projects to { artifact: "ESCALATION" }, the second to { artifact: "CONTRACT" }, and the third throws so the case becomes ERROR carrying the malformed record's defect
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the two projections deep-equal their objects and that the third case's report.json error field contains the defect text readPlannerEscalation returned

behaviors.given: scratch directories holding a review-pm.md that parseGuardianReview resolves to FIX-BEFORE-SHIP and a review-architect.md whose content parseGuardianReview resolves to UNPARSEABLE, the latter in a case whose expected outcome is SHIP
behaviors.then: the pm case's projection is { outcome: "FIX-BEFORE-SHIP" } and the architect case is a MISMATCH carrying actual { outcome: "UNPARSEABLE" }, never an ERROR
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the pm projection, and asserts the architect case entry in report.json has outcome MISMATCH with actual.outcome "UNPARSEABLE" and no error key

behaviors.given: a four-case pack with stubs that write no artifact, write two copies of the role's artifact in different subdirectories, write content whose production parser throws, and return InvokeResult.exitCode 3
behaviors.then: each case's outcome is ERROR — naming the searched filename, listing both matches, carrying the parser's message, and naming code 3 respectively — and the run still writes report.json and exits 0
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the four error strings and that exitCode is 0 with report.json present and counts.ERROR === 4

behaviors.given: a one-case pack and a stub whose invoke rejects with a transient provider error
behaviors.then: the case outcome is ERROR carrying the rejection message, invoke was called exactly once with no retry, and callsUsed is 1
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the stub's recorded call count is 1, the case's error contains the rejection message, and report.json callsUsed === 1

behaviors.given: a three-case pack dispatched once with --max-calls 2 and once with no --max-calls flag
behaviors.then: the capped run dispatches cases one and two, marks case three NOT-RUN, reports callsUsed 2 and status INCOMPLETE; the uncapped run reports maxCalls 50 and status COMPLETE
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the stub recorded two invocations for the capped run, the third case entry's outcome is NOT-RUN with callsUsed 0, and report.json maxCalls is 2 then 50

behaviors.given: argument vectors --pack <dir> --max-calls 0, --pack <dir> --max-calls two, and one with no --pack at all
behaviors.then: each returns exitCode 2, dispatches nothing, writes no report.json, and returns the usage text in output
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts exitCode 2 for all three, that output contains "eval --pack <dir>", that the stub recorded zero invocations, and that no eval-<timestamp> directory was created

behaviors.given: a three-case pack whose stub produces one MATCH, one MISMATCH and one ERROR
behaviors.then: compareProjection returned MATCH only for the first, the MATCH case's scratch directory no longer exists, and the MISMATCH and ERROR cases' scratch directories still exist with their paths recorded as scratchDir on exactly those two entries
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts existsSync is false for the MATCH scratch path and true for the other two, that report.json records scratchDir only for the kept ones, and that compareProjection is a pure function returning MATCH/MISMATCH by field-by-field string equality

behaviors.given: a completed run over a mixed-outcome pack and, separately, a report.json edited to version 2
behaviors.then: the first reads back an EvalReport carrying version 1, status, provider, pack, packVersion, startedAt, finishedAt, maxCalls, callsUsed, counts with exactly the keys MATCH, MISMATCH, NOT-RUN and ERROR, and cases in declared order; the second is refused for its unsupported version
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the top-level key set, that Object.keys(counts) equals the four names, that case ids appear in declared order, that EVAL_REPORT_VERSION === 1, and that reading the version-2 file throws naming the version

behaviors.given: a completed run producing one case of each outcome (MATCH, MISMATCH, ERROR, NOT-RUN) where the provider reports no cost or tool-call stats
behaviors.then: every cases entry carries exactly id, role, source, outcome, expected and callsUsed (0 or 1); actual only on the MATCH and MISMATCH entries; error only on the ERROR entry; scratchDir only on the MISMATCH and ERROR entries; durationMs only on the three dispatched entries; and no key outside that exhaustive list plus B-20's costUsd and toolCallCount
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts each entry's exact own-key set for all four outcomes, so an added or missing key fails

behaviors.given: three runs: one where every dispatched case's InvocationStats reports costUsd and toolCallCount, one where only the first of two does, and one where none does
behaviors.then: the first carries per-case costUsd and toolCallCount and a top-level costUsd equal to their sum; the second carries them on the first case only and omits the top-level costUsd; the third omits all of them rather than writing 0
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the top-level costUsd value and its absence by key, and asserts absence (not zero) of the per-case keys where unreported

behaviors.given: a completed run over a mixed-outcome pack with deps.stdout capturing every streamed line
behaviors.then: formatEvalSummary produced exactly "afk eval <status>: MATCH <n> / MISMATCH <n> / NOT-RUN <n> / ERROR <n> — calls <used>/<max> — <path>", that line is the whole of the returned output, it was never passed to deps.stdout, and neither report.json nor any emitted line contains a rate, ratio or percentage
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts output equals the expected summary string, asserts the captured stdout lines contain only per-case lines (no line appears in both), and asserts no "%", "rate", "ratio" or "/ of" text in output, in the streamed lines, or in report.json's bytes

behaviors.given: a three-case pack and an injected deps.stdout that appends each line to an array
behaviors.then: the captured array holds exactly three lines, in declared order, of the shape "[<k>/<n>] <id> (<role>) <outcome>" with k running 1..3 and n === 3
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the captured array deep-equals the three expected strings and that formatCaseLine(k, n, result) returns the same string for each

behaviors.given: a two-case pack whose stub mismatches both cases, and a three-case pack run with --max-calls 1
behaviors.then: both return exitCode 0 with report.json written; the second's report status is INCOMPLETE
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts exitCode === 0 and existsSync(reportPath) for both runs and status "INCOMPLETE" for the capped one

behaviors.given: four invocations: a refused pack (unknown top-level member), a missing --pack, an --out path that cannot be created (a path whose parent is an existing file), and a valid two-case pack whose injected deps.stdout throws on the first per-case line after that case was dispatched
behaviors.then: the first three return exitCode 2 with no report.json — the refusal naming the file and the member in output — and the fourth returns exitCode 1 with no report.json written, because a throw from the runner's own seams after dispatch began is not absorbed the way a provider-side failure is (B-13, B-14)
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts exitCode 2, 2, 2 then 1, asserts no report.json exists for any of the four, asserts the refusal message names the file and the member, and asserts the stub recorded exactly one invocation in the exit-1 run

behaviors.given: a valid three-case pack and a refused pack, each run with --dry-run
behaviors.then: the valid run exits 0 with output holding one "<id> (<role>) — <source>" line per case in declared order, and the refused run exits 2 with the refusal message; neither dispatches anything nor creates the output directory
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the three output lines, exitCode 0 then 2, that the stub recorded zero invocations, and that no eval-<timestamp> directory exists under --out

behaviors.given: the exported runEvalCli(args, repoRoot, provider, deps = DEFAULT_EVAL_DEPS): Promise<{ output: string; exitCode: 0 | 1 | 2 }> with EvalCliDeps carrying now(), mkScratchDir(id) and stdout(line), and the three CLI entry sources
behaviors.when: a run uses an injected now() and a test reads each entry's source
behaviors.then: the output directory is <out>/eval-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>/ derived from now() with --out defaulting to <repoRoot>/.afk/eval, and each of src/afk.ts, src/afk-claude.ts and src/afk-codex.ts contains an args[0] === "eval" branch before its parsePipelineRuntimeOptions call that delegates to runEvalCli with that entry's provider (kiroProvider, Claude, Codex), prints output on exit 0 and to stderr otherwise, and one usage() line containing "eval --pack <dir> [--max-calls <n>] [--out <dir>] [--dry-run]"
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the created directory name for a fixed injected clock and the default --out path, and a source-reading test asserts the branch, its position before parsePipelineRuntimeOptions, the bound provider name and the usage line in all three entries

behaviors.given: the scanned set declared by this behavior — every src/*.ts file whose name matches neither *.test.ts nor *.fixtures.ts, minus src/eval-pack.ts, src/eval-compare.ts, src/eval-report.ts, src/eval-command.ts and the three CLI entries — a set that therefore excludes the test-support module src/eval.fixtures.ts, which imports ./eval-pack.js by design
behaviors.when: src/eval-boundary.test.ts reads each file in that set and collects every file whose import specifiers match /\.\/eval-(pack|compare|report|command)\.js/
behaviors.then: the collected offender list is empty, and the set is demonstrably non-empty and contains src/orchestrator.ts, src/wave.ts, src/ship-gate.ts, src/preship.ts, src/gate-runner.ts, src/base-gates.ts, src/candidate-gate-phase.ts and src/post-qa-gates.ts
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test in src/eval-boundary.test.ts named for B-27 asserts the offender list deep-equals [] over that stated set, asserts the set contains the eight named production modules, and asserts src/eval.fixtures.ts is not a member of the set — so the gate's evidence is evidence for the declared rule

behaviors.given: the committed pack eval-packs/fixtures/refused/01-unknown-member.json carrying one otherwise valid case with one unknown top-level member
behaviors.when: readEvalPack is called on eval-packs/fixtures/refused and that directory is listed recursively
behaviors.then: the pack is refused with an error naming that unknown member, and eval-packs/fixtures/refused/ contains no other file, since every other refusing pack of B-02–B-07 lives in a per-test temporary directory; the listing is bounded to the directory this slice owns rather than to all of eval-packs/, so the sibling packs #263 adds under eval-packs/afk/ and eval-packs/fixtures/consumer-governance/ on the same feature branch cannot falsify it at the pre-ship gate
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test in src/eval-pack.test.ts named for B-28 asserts the refusal message contains the file name and the unknown member, and asserts a recursive listing of eval-packs/fixtures/refused/ equals exactly ["01-unknown-member.json"]

behaviors.given: the slice's own test files under src/
behaviors.then: every runEvalCli call site passes the stub provider exported by src/eval.fixtures.ts and no test imports a real provider module (./claude.js, ./codex.js, ./kiro.js)
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts no src/*.test.ts file that mentions runEvalCli imports a real provider module, and that the stub is the only provider constructor used

behaviors.given: CONTEXT.md with its existing ### Pipeline concepts section and the already-merged **Prompt record** entry
behaviors.when: a test reads CONTEXT.md and every src/eval-*.ts file
behaviors.then: CONTEXT.md contains the four entries **Envelope**, **Scenario pack**, **Eval case** and **Eval outcome** with the D36 text under Pipeline concepts, each with a prose body and an _Avoid_ line, the **Prompt record** entry is still present and unedited, and the word "disposition" appears in none of the four new entries nor in any src/eval-*.ts file
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the four **Term**: headings exist after the Pipeline concepts heading with their _Avoid_ lines, asserts **Prompt record** still present, and asserts a case-insensitive search for "disposition" finds nothing in the new entries or the eval modules

behaviors.source: GH #262 AC32 (prd.md D32; ARCHITECTURE.md module table)
behaviors.given: ARCHITECTURE.md's existing module table and its 150-line cap
behaviors.then: exactly one row's Module cell is "Agent eval", its public-seam cell names src/eval-command.ts, its internals cell names src/eval-pack.ts, src/eval-compare.ts and src/eval-report.ts, and the file is at most 150 lines
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts one matching row, its two cells' contents, and the line count

behaviors.given: the three CLI entry sources after the eval branch is added
behaviors.then: src/afk.ts still dispatches status, stop, clean-failed and adopt in that order, src/afk-claude.ts and src/afk-codex.ts still dispatch stop and clean-failed, every entry still calls parsePipelineRuntimeOptions after the bare-token branches, and each entry's runPipeline call site is intact
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the presence and relative source order of each existing branch, the parsePipelineRuntimeOptions call after them, and one runPipeline call per entry

behaviors.source: prd.md "Verified facts" (src/contract-review.ts:369, src/qa-review.ts:346, src/final-evaluation.ts:305, src/artifacts.ts:308, src/planner-escalation.ts:125, src/acceptance-manifest.ts:201)
behaviors.given: the six production parsers and readers the projection depends on
behaviors.when: the eval modules and this slice's diff are inspected
behaviors.then: each parser is imported from its production module and called with its existing signature, no eval module re-implements or copies one, and none of the six modules is modified by this slice
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts src/eval-compare.ts's import specifiers include the six production modules, that no eval module declares a function named like one of the parsers, and that the six files are absent from this slice's declared file scope

behaviors.given: vitest.config.ts and the repository layout after this slice
behaviors.when: a test reads the config and the eval pack location
behaviors.then: the include array is still exactly ["src/**/*.test.ts"] and every committed pack lives outside src/, so pnpm test runs no eval scenario against a live model
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the include array's contents and that no file under src/ is a pack case file

behaviors.given: .gitignore's .afk/ entry and runEvalCli with no --out flag
behaviors.then: .gitignore still ignores .afk/ and the default output directory resolves to <repoRoot>/.afk/eval, so a report is never a committed diffable artifact
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts .gitignore still contains the .afk/ line and that a default-out run wrote its report under <repoRoot>/.afk/eval/eval-<timestamp>/report.json

behaviors.given: the four eval modules and the pipeline's run-evidence machinery
behaviors.when: a source-level test reads the eval modules' import specifiers and the two version constants
behaviors.then: no eval module imports ./run-events.js, ./run-journal.js, ./run-state.js, ./run-identity.js, ./git.js or ./logger.js, and EVENTS_SCHEMA_VERSION is still 1 and RUN_STATE_VERSION still 5
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test asserts the offender list of forbidden imports is empty and asserts both constants' values
